cases.question: List the author name for every recorded authorship at a Canadian university, retaining duplicate records.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name FROM WROTE w JOIN AUTHOR a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN UNIVERSITY u ON a.uni_id = u.uid WHERE u.country = 'CA';
cases.sqlp: SELECT w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.university.country = 'CA';

cases.question: Which distinct author names occur on recorded authorships at Canadian universities?
cases.sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM WROTE w JOIN AUTHOR a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN UNIVERSITY u ON a.uni_id = u.uid WHERE u.country = 'CA';
cases.sqlp: SELECT DISTINCT w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.university.country = 'CA';

cases.question: List the author name for every recorded authorship at a Canadian university whose paper is published by a Danish university, retaining duplicate records.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name FROM WROTE w JOIN AUTHOR a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN UNIVERSITY u ON a.uni_id = u.uid JOIN PAPER p ON w.paper_pid = p.pid JOIN UNIVERSITY pub ON p.publisher_uid = pub.uid WHERE u.country = 'CA' AND pub.country = 'DK';
cases.sqlp: SELECT w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.university.country = 'CA' AND w.paper.publisher.country = 'DK';

cases.question: List each author's name, mentor's name, and mentor's mentor's name when that last person's identifier is 1.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name, m.name, mm.name FROM AUTHOR a JOIN AUTHOR m ON a.mentor_aid = m.aid JOIN AUTHOR mm ON m.mentor_aid = mm.aid WHERE mm.aid = 1;
cases.sqlp: SELECT a.name, a.mentor.name, a.mentor.mentor.name FROM AUTHOR a WHERE a.mentor.mentor.aid = 1;

cases.question: List author names on recorded authorships at universities with country code US.
cases.sql: SELECT a.name FROM WROTE w JOIN AUTHOR a ON w.author_aid = a.aid JOIN UNIVERSITY u ON a.uni_id = u.uid WHERE u.country = 'US';
cases.sqlp: SELECT w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.university.country = 'US';

cases.question: List the paper title and author name for recorded authorships with author identifier 2 and paper title Databases.
cases.sql: SELECT p.title, a.name FROM WROTE w JOIN PAPER p ON w.paper_pid = p.pid JOIN AUTHOR a ON w.author_aid = a.aid WHERE a.aid = 2 AND p.title = 'Databases';
cases.sqlp: SELECT w.paper.title, w.author.name FROM WROTE w WHERE w.author.aid = 2 AND w.paper.title = 'Databases';
